title: PRISMA: A Python Toolkit for Systematic Literature Reviews

creators.name: Cuervo, Javier
creators.affiliation: Universidade de Aveiro (DEGEIT, DBI) and Proportione, LDA

description:
PRISMA is a modular Python toolkit for reproducible systematic literature reviews. It covers corpus ingestion (OpenAlex, RIS), cross-source deduplication, title-abstract screening with a YAML rule engine and audit log, full-text extraction with PyMuPDF, MMAT 2018 quality assessment, PRISMA 2020 flow diagrams, bibliometric analysis (Louvain clusters, keyword co-occurrence, VOSviewer integration) and correlation and robustness statistics (Fisher-z confidence intervals, partial correlation, bootstrap, missingness checks, mixed-model ICC). It ships a command-line interface and a Streamlit demo.

The toolkit is not affiliated with or endorsed by the PRISMA Statement Group or the EQUATOR Network.
